code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi resources/sftp/sftp-common.properties (no State Courts folder), application-prod.properties (sftp.upload.allowedSources), framework/workflows/agencies (ces, lta, mha, repccs, toppan, vhub; no court). ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_management/filedownload/downloadfile/FileDownloadController (generic blob download), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase. ocmsadminui utils/models/Icourtmention.d.ts (type only). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: Sheet status is blank; demo remark: 'Removed from demo list - can't verify'. The story is traced normally. The story asks OCMS to receive, process and store daily files with scheduled mention case details (information list, pagination list) from State Courts so they can be downloaded. Not found: a State Courts SFTP folder or job, a mention file parser, a courtmention entity/table (only the TypeScript type Icourtmention and a path list in api-authorization.properties:23 with no controller), or storage of mention files. The only relevant thing that exists is the generic blob download endpoint (POST download/blob) that can download files from a known source key or a direct blob path; there is no court source key and no court file is stored, so the download step is only Sebagian. Searched with synonyms mention, pagination, information list, state court, court file across the six repos. No relevant maintenance ticket. SFTP partner: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. There is no receiving, processing or storing of State Courts mention files; only the generic blob download could be reused. The demo remark itself says it cannot be verified.

steps.step: State Courts send daily files with scheduled mention case details (information list, pagination list)
steps.detail: There is no SFTP folder, server or allowed source for State Courts; the defined folders are only ces, mha, toppan, lta, repccs, icms, vhub. The State Courts sender side: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS receives the daily files (scheduled download job)
steps.detail: The workflows/agencies folder contains only ces, lta, mha, repccs, toppan, vhub; no job or scheduler fetches court files. There is no court cron entry in cron-schedules-prod.properties.

steps.step: OCMS processes the file content (information list, pagination list) into mention data
steps.detail: There is no courtmention parser or entity in the backend. Icourtmention (mention_date, summon_no, court_no, mention_outcome, ...) is only a TypeScript type; /v1/courtmention is listed in api-authorization.properties:23 but no controller or entity serves it.

No code stores court files to blob or database. The download source-key list (TOPPAN, LTA, MHA, DATAHIVE, ENOTIF, UNCLAIMED, TEMPLATE, UEN, FIN) has no court entry (FileDownloadController.java:108-110).

steps.step: The Court Processing Officer downloads the files from OCMS when needed
steps.detail: A generic download endpoint POST download/blob exists (source key or direct blob path + fileName), guarded by the OCMS_NOTICE_CREATE mapping (api-authorization.properties:31), and could serve a court file if one existed. But no court file is stored, there is no court source key, and no staff portal page for mention files (Vault covers only Datahive and LTA). This is a generic mechanism, not the feature the story names.
